decision: Resolve G-ARCH-002 as option (b): descope re-verify — the diff-gate covers round-2 re-review only
alternatives: option (a): gate the verifier re-spawn in execute.ts re-entry and carry forward prior verify.json
reasoning: Pipeline order execute->checks->verify->review means the review.ts gate fires after re-verify already ran; option (a) needs a second gate location plus a verify.json carry-forward protocol (wider risk), and the zero-overlap condition is only provably safe for review findings — acceptance criteria can regress from changes outside flagged locations, so gating re-verify would breach the never-sacrifice-quality HARD CONSTRAINT
risk: residual cost: one verifier subagent still re-runs on no-op fix iterations

decision: Canonical re-entry diff = git diff <pre-fix-sha> --name-only unioned with git ls-files --others --exclude-standard (working-tree-inclusive)
alternatives: git status --porcelain when pre-fix SHA == HEAD; keep <sha>..HEAD form
reasoning: Stage-gate blocks commits during EXECUTING so HEAD never moves — <sha>..HEAD is always empty on the live path and inverts the gate; the diff+ls-files union covers staged, unstaged, and untracked changes with two deterministic commands and keeps one uniform token across all gate bodies
risk: two-command union must be described consistently in every body — mitigated by ac-08/ac-09 per-file greps

decision: Named the re-entry gate 'Step 3.5' and embedded post-skip routing inside the gate block, before Step 4
alternatives: Fold gate into Step 7 Route B routing
reasoning: File already uses fractional step naming (Step 4.5, Step 5.5); plan mandates the gate sit before Step 4 and post-skip routing be part of the gate algorithm
risk: Downstream prose referencing step numbers could assume integer-only steps
reviewHint: Confirm Step 3.5 placement reads naturally between Automated Checks and the fan-out

decision: Anchored the re-entry diff gate at the top of Step 8 (after the no-changed-files check) and keyed re-entry detection on the --quality-fixes pass, since phase-execute has no reviewIteration counter like modes/review.ts Step 3.5
alternatives: Place the gate inside Step 8.1 before re-presenting findings
Introduce an explicit iteration counter mirroring reviewIteration
reasoning: Step 8 top is where the fan-out is initiated, so gating there prevents the spawn cost; --quality-fixes is the file's existing native re-entry signal (L21 args, Step 8.1 EXIT route), so no new state is needed
risk: If a future flow re-enters Step 8 without --quality-fixes after a fix round, the gate would not engage and a full (safe but costly) re-review runs
reviewHint: Check gate placement after the no-changed-files early-exit and the SHA stash bullet in Step 8.1 CRITICAL route

decision: Kept literal 'MUST-FIX and SHOULD-FIX' in phase-execute Step 8 gate with a parenthetical mapping to that skill's CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM severity scheme
alternatives: Use CRITICAL/HIGH-MEDIUM vocabulary throughout with one MUST-FIX parenthetical
reasoning: MF2 mandates the cite-set wording in all three gate bodies and the rendered greps re-check literal token uniformity; the parenthetical preserves the skill-local severity mapping dx-advocate flagged
risk: Slight verbosity in the gate step; an agent could still conflate MEDIUM findings with SHOULD-FIX scope
